Southlands is an MLS® sub-area of Vancouver. Between November 2025 to October 22, 2026, 35 homes sold there: 26 houses and 5 condos. 26 houses sold in Southlands with a median price of $2,966,250 (the middle half sold between $2,500,000 and $3,678,125), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 94.6% of the last list price; 4% sold above list.
Southlands home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

26 houses sold in Southlands with a median price of $2,966,250 (the middle half sold between $2,500,000 and $3,678,125), taking a median of 28 days to sell at 94.6% of the last list price; 4% sold above list. They had a median $857 per square foot, a median year built of 1970 and a median lot of 8,552 square feet. 5 condos sold in Southlands with a median price of $780,000, taking a median of 97 days to sell at 94.5% of the last list price; 0% sold above list. They had a median $845 per square foot, a median year built of 2001 and a median strata fee of $657 a month.

items.t: The City's South Lands Plan describes it as a low-lying area of southwest Vancouver along the Fraser River, between Marpole and the University Endowment Lands and south of SW Marine Drive.
The plan names Blenheim Flats ("Horse Village"), West Southlands and the Angus Lands (Angus West and Angus East) as parts of the area.
The South Lands Plan was approved by Council on March 8, 1988 and last amended June 30, 2024.
Over two-thirds of the area is zoned RA-1 (Limited Agricultural); most of the rest is RS-1. The plan aims to keep it low-density and semi-rural.
Single-family zoning was set for Angus West and light industrial/office for Angus East.
A significant part has been in the Agricultural Land Reserve since 1973; the plan supports that status.

A 2019 City memo says RA-1 allows a one-family dwelling up to 280 m² outright, and that ALC rules cap ALR homes at 500 m²; about 160 Southlands ALR parcels are under 2 acres and may be exempt after title review.
The ALC currently allows one principal residence of up to 500 m² without approval; larger or additional residences may need ALC approval.

blocks.text: Southlands: parks, community facilities and shopping

items.t: Land uses named in the plan are golf courses, equestrian properties and nurseries; the Southlands Riding Club is named.
The plan (1988 figures) counted about 400 horses, mostly in commercial boarding stables.

blocks.text: Southlands: risks and rules a buyer should know

items.t: The South Lands Plan states most of the area is in the Fraser River floodplain. The City names the Fraser foreshore as its most flood-exposed area.
ALR status and RA-1 zoning limit house size, extra dwellings and non-farm use; the City says General Order #291/89, which let it approve RA-1 uses without the ALC, was rescinded June 10, 2019.
Check the ALC and the City before relying on a second dwelling or subdivision for any lot.
Empty Homes Tax: annual declaration; 3% of assessed value for properties deemed or declared empty in the 2025 reference year (page as retrieved Nov 2026).

faq.q: What did homes in Southlands sell for?
faq.a: 26 houses sold in Southlands between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $2,966,250.

faq.q: How long do homes take to sell in Southlands?
faq.a: The median was 28 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 94.6% of the last list price (4% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.

faq.q: What price range do most houses in Southlands sell in?
faq.a: The middle half of the 26 houses that sold in Southlands went for between $2,500,000 and $3,678,125, around a median of $2,966,250.

faq.q: Do houses in Southlands sell above asking price?
faq.a: 4% of the 26 houses sold for more than the last list price, and the median sale was 94.6% of it.

faq.q: How old are the houses that sold in Southlands?
faq.a: The median year built was 1970 for the 26 houses sold in Southlands.

faq.q: How many bedrooms do houses in Southlands usually have?
faq.a: The median house that sold in Southlands had 4 bedrooms, from the 26 sales between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
